question: How many Members of Parliament were elected to the 17th Lok Sabha from Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**21**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **21 Members of Parliament** were elected to the 17th Lok Sabha from Odisha.
 
• The Lok Sabha, or House of the People, is the lower house of India's bicameral Parliament, with members elected directly by the people of India.
 
• The 17th Lok Sabha elections were held in 2019, and Odisha elected 21 representatives to the house.
 
• O
